/images/ceh/m02-08-01-layered-controls-z:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0208-f1-zh-title m0208-f1-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0208-f1-zh-title">圖 1｜依保護目標選控制</title>
<desc id="m0208-f1-zh-desc">公開內容、搜尋索引、資料權限與服務設定，各自對應保護目標。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0208-f1-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 1｜依保護目標選控制</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">公開內容</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留菜單、營業時間與正式窗口</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">文件另製公開版，檢查中繼資料</text>
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">搜尋呈現</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">公開頁的 noindex 管理索引</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">讓支援規則的爬蟲取得指示</text>
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">資料存取</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">驗證身分，再檢查每項權限</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">頁面與直接檔案下載使用同一規則</text>
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">服務管理</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">盤點入口、更新軟體、管理退役</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依需求設定網路與管理介面</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依資料用途組合控制，驗收各自的效果。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-08-02-observation-infere:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0208-f2-zh-title m0208-f2-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0208-f2-zh-title">圖 2｜觀察、推論、行動分開記</title>
<desc id="m0208-f2-zh-desc">由直接觀察形成可檢驗推論，再指定經授權的處理與驗收。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0208-f2-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 2｜觀察、推論、行動分開記</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">觀察 Observation</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">未登入時，測試頁顯示合成名單</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄時間、來源、角色與取得方法</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">推論 Inference</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">公開存取與內部測試用途有落差</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">列目前可信程度與待核事項</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">行動 Action</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">由網站負責人修正伺服器端授權</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">另定負責人、期限與驗收方法</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">複核 Review</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">三種角色與直接下載路徑重測</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">以實際結果更新發現狀態</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">情境與角色均為合成教學資料。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-08-03-evidence-custody-z:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0208-f3-zh-title m0208-f3-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0208-f3-zh-title">圖 3｜原始資料與保管紀錄相互連結</title>
<desc id="m0208-f3-zh-desc">原始檔受控保存；工作副本用於分析與遮罩；取得、交付與操作另留紀錄。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0208-f3-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 3｜原始資料與保管紀錄相互連結</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">取得與識別</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">發現編號、來源、取得人、時間與時區</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄授權範圍及取得方式</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">保存原始資料</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">受控位置、原始檔案、SHA-256</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">摘要用於核對位元組一致性</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">建立工作副本</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">另存分析與遮罩版</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留副本與原檔的關聯及處理方式</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">追蹤保管與使用</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">誰、何時、做什麼、目的與位置</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依程序管理權限、期限與交付</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">公開報告用遮罩版；原始資料依授權保存。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-08-04-remediation-verifi:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0208-f4-zh-title m0208-f4-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0208-f4-zh-title">圖 4｜改善有成果，結案有驗收</title>
<desc id="m0208-f4-zh-desc">F-008 由待查核到已驗收，保留變更、角色測試與實際結果。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0208-f4-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 4｜改善有成果，結案有驗收</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">待查核</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">確認來源、現況與授權</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">把第三方聲稱列為待核線索</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">已確認待處理</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄用途落差、風險、負責人與期限</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">安排權限及直接下載路徑的改善</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">已改善待驗收</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">未登入｜一般員工｜核准測試人員</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">以原問題與同樣路徑複測</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">已驗收</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保存時間、版本與每項實際結果</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">外部副本與後續複查另行追蹤</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">每次狀態改變都有紀錄；新問題重新開啟。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-08-01-layered-controls-e:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0208-f1-en-title m0208-f1-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0208-f1-en-title">1 | Match controls to protection goals</title>
<desc id="m0208-f1-en-desc">Public content, search indexing, access permissions and service settings each serve a protection goal.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0208-f1-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">1 | Match controls to protection goals</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Public content</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Keep menus, hours and official contacts</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Publish reviewed, versioned public copies</text>
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Search presentation</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Use noindex to manage public-page indexing</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Let supporting crawlers read the directive</text>
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Data access</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Authenticate, then authorize each request</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Apply permissions to pages and direct files</text>
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Service management</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Inventory, patch and retire services</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Scope networks and management interfaces</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Combine controls by purpose; verify each outcome.</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-08-02-observation-infere:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0208-f2-en-title m0208-f2-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0208-f2-en-title">2 | Separate observation, inference and action</title>
<desc id="m0208-f2-en-desc">Use direct observations to form testable interpretations and assign authorized action and verification.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0208-f2-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">2 | Separate observation, inference and action</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Observation</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">A signed-out test page shows synthetic names</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Record time, source, role and method</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0208-f2-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Inference</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Public access differs from the internal purpose</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">State confidence and remaining checks</text>
